name: NexoBow Autonomous - 02 Recordatorios 24h/2h & Lista de Espera FIFO

parameters.query: WITH due AS (SELECT a.id, a.client_slug, a.patient_phone_e164, a.patient_first_name, a.specialty, a.scheduled_at, CASE WHEN a.confirmed_2h = false AND a.scheduled_at BETWEEN now() + interval '90 minutes' AND now() + interval '150 minutes' THEN '2h' WHEN a.confirmed_24h = false AND a.scheduled_at BETWEEN now() + interval '23 hours 30 minutes' AND now() + interval '24 hours 30 minutes' THEN '24h' END AS reminder_type FROM appointments a WHERE a.status IN ('pendiente', 'confirmado') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_state cs WHERE cs.client_slug = a.client_slug AND cs.patient_phone_hash = a.patient_phone_hash AND cs.opted_out = true)) SELECT d.* FROM due d WHERE d.reminder_type IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder_dispatches rd WHERE rd.appointment_id = d.id AND rd.reminder_type = d.reminder_type AND rd.status <> 'fallido') ORDER BY d.scheduled_at ASC;

INSERT INTO reminder_dispatches (appointment_id, reminder_type, status, provider_message_id) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, 'enviado', $3) ON CONFLICT (appointment_id, reminder_type) DO UPDATE SET status = 'enviado', provider_message_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.provider_message_id, reminder_dispatches.provider_message_id), dispatched_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE reminder_dispatches.status = 'fallido';

nodes.name: Expirar Ofertas Vencidas y Rotar FIFO

parameters.query: WITH expired AS (UPDATE waitlist_entries SET status = 'expirado', updated_at = now() WHERE status = 'ofertado' AND offer_expires_at <= now() RETURNING id, client_slug, specialty, offered_slot_id, offer_expires_at), expired_ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY client_slug, specialty ORDER BY offer_expires_at ASC, id ASC) AS rn FROM expired), candidates_ranked AS (SELECT id, client_slug, specialty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY client_slug, specialty ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC) AS rn FROM waitlist_entries WHERE status = 'esperando' AND consent_waitlist = true AND opted_out = false), paired AS (SELECT e.offered_slot_id, c.id AS waitlist_id FROM expired_ranked e JOIN candidates_ranked c ON c.client_slug = e.client_slug AND c.specialty = e.specialty AND c.rn = e.rn) UPDATE waitlist_entries target SET status = 'ofertado', offered_slot_id = p.offered_slot_id, offer_expires_at = now() + interval '45 minutes', updated_at = now() FROM paired p WHERE target.id = p.waitlist_id RETURNING target.id AS waitlist_id, target.client_slug, target.specialty, target.patient_phone_e164 AS offer_phone_e164, target.patient_first_name AS offer_first_name, target.offered_slot_id, target.offer_expires_at;

nodes.name: Webhook Respuesta Turno y Lista Espera
Postgres Actualizar Turno y Ofertar FIFO Ley 25.326

parameters.query: WITH updated_app AS (UPDATE appointments SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'confirmar' THEN 'confirmado' WHEN $2 = 'reprogramar' THEN 'reprogramado' ELSE 'cancelado' END, confirmed_24h = CASE WHEN $2 = 'confirmar' AND $3 = '24h' THEN true ELSE confirmed_24h END, confirmed_2h = CASE WHEN $2 = 'confirmar' AND $3 = '2h' THEN true ELSE confirmed_2h END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, client_slug, specialty, scheduled_at, patient_phone_hash, status), fifo_pick AS (SELECT u.id AS slot_id, w.id AS waitlist_id FROM updated_app u JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM waitlist_entries cand WHERE cand.client_slug = u.client_slug AND cand.specialty = u.specialty AND cand.status = 'esperando' AND cand.consent_waitlist = true AND cand.opted_out = false AND cand.patient_phone_hash <> u.patient_phone_hash ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1) w ON u.status IN ('cancelado', 'reprogramado')), offered AS (UPDATE waitlist_entries target SET status = 'ofertado', offered_slot_id = fp.slot_id, offer_expires_at = now() + interval '45 minutes', updated_at = now() FROM fifo_pick fp WHERE target.id = fp.waitlist_id RETURNING target.id AS waitlist_id, target.client_slug, target.specialty, target.patient_phone_e164, target.patient_first_name, target.offered_slot_id, target.offer_expires_at) SELECT u.client_slug, u.specialty, u.status AS appointment_status, COALESCE((SELECT waitlist_id::text FROM offered LIMIT 1), '') AS waitlist_id, COALESCE((SELECT offered_slot_id::text FROM offered LIMIT 1), '') AS offered_slot_id, COALESCE((SELECT patient_phone_e164 FROM offered LIMIT 1), '') AS offer_phone_e164, COALESCE((SELECT patient_first_name FROM offered LIMIT 1), '') AS offer_first_name FROM updated_app u;
